about: Parity layers (ADR-0003 section 3): one row per layer and scale, each pending or enforced, each with its owner issue. The issue that lands a layer's producer switches its own rows to enforced. Read by TkzParity's LayerManifest; checked by Tests/TkzParityTests/LayerManifestTests.swift. See docs/linux/parity.md.
